mappings.note: Contains the superscription 'To the choir director... servant of David' which is not present in OSMAIN v1 (which starts with 'Sin speaks'). This text must be added to OSMAIN or mapped as extra content.
Contains the first part of OSMAIN v1 ('Sin speaks... no fear of God'). The superscription in WLC v1 is separate.
Matches OSMAIN v2 ('He flatters himself... sin not detected').
Matches OSMAIN v3 ('Words of his mouth are evil and deceit... ceased to be wise').
Matches OSMAIN v4 ('He plots evil on his bed... does not reject what is bad').
Matches OSMAIN v5 ('Your mercy in the heavens... faithfulness to clouds').
Matches OSMAIN v6 ('Righteousness like mountains... saves man and beast').
Matches OSMAIN v7 ('How precious is your mercy... shelter in shadow of wings').
Matches OSMAIN v8 ('Satisfied with abundance... drink from stream of delights').
Matches OSMAIN v9 ('With you is the fountain of life... in your light we see light').
Matches OSMAIN v10 ('Continue mercy to those who know you... righteousness to upright heart').
Matches OSMAIN v11 ('Let not the foot of pride come over me... hand of wicked drive me away').
Matches OSMAIN v12 ('There fell workers of iniquity... cast down and could not rise').

extraContent.description: Superscription: 'To the choir director. Of the servant of David.' (לַמְנַצֵּחַ ׀ לְעֶבֶד־יְהוָה לְדָוִד׃). This text appears in WLC v1 but is missing from OSMAIN v1, which begins directly with the psalm content ('Sin speaks...').
